info.title: FlowWork AI - Client collaboration and secure portal
info.description: Implemented Phases 3-7. Current database identity and scoped authorization on every request. Separate client memberships, explicit grants, allowlisted portal DTOs, publication, feedback, change review and versioned approvals. Live schema rollout requires separate approval.

servers.description: Configurable local development HTTP listener. Production URL must be supplied by the deployment environment.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Real MongoDB identity. Bootstrap CSRF first; unsafe requests require an allowlisted Origin and X-CSRF-Token. Access/refresh credentials never appear in JSON.

tags.name: Tenancy
tags.description: Organization and workspace scopes are distinct. All unsafe requests require signed CSRF plus exact Origin.

tags.name: Work management
tags.description: Current database workspace membership and project permissions required. All writes are transactional and recorded with server-owned activity.

post.summary: Register a real user pending email verification
post.description: Global API IP limit applies. Credential/action endpoints additionally share 20 attempts per 15 minutes/IP. Email resend/recovery issuance has a 60-second per-account guard. Preflight is handled by exact-origin CORS. All unsafe methods require CSRF including pre-auth requests. Generic 202 for new/existing email prevents an explicit account-existence oracle; no automatic session, workspace or membership is created. Capture mode writes local development mail, not actual delivery.

path.description: Known request schema path, for example body.count.

message.description: Safe validation guidance without rejected values.

label.description: Trimmed before validation; the trimmed value must contain 2-80 UTF-16 code units. Whitespace-only labels fail. The raw body is bounded by 16 KiB.

characterCount.description: Normalized label length in UTF-16 code units.

email.description: Trimmed and lowercased across the whole address; provider-specific dot/plus rewriting is not performed.

csrfToken.description: Signed nonce bound to the HttpOnly pre-session cookie or refresh family; not an access credential.

accessCookie.name: __Host-fw_access
accessCookie.description: Production HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax Path=/ host-only JWT cookie, 10-minute default. Development uses fw_access without Secure on loopback HTTP. Every request checks the active database user and session.

refreshCookie.name: __Host-fw_refresh
refreshCookie.description: Production HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax Path=/ host-only opaque rotating refresh cookie. Development uses fw_refresh. Default idle 7 days, absolute 30 days, history cap 512; replay revokes the family.

csrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfHeader.description: Obtain from GET /auth/csrf; requires matching HttpOnly CSRF/context cookies and an exact allowlisted Origin. Token rotates on login/refresh; bootstrap before retrying a CSRF rejection.
